Change each type of virtual mouse cursor with a step-by-step guide and animated examples.
Choose the cursor type to change
This is the main cursor. It appears all the time in menus, in the inventory and on any game screen. Works in any Minecraft version.
Appears when the cursor hovers over something clickable, such as buttons and links. Only works in Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.
Appears when the cursor hovers over a field where you can type, such as the chat and search boxes. Only works in Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.
Crosshair-shaped cursor (+). Appears when the game or a mod requests the crosshair cursor. Only works in Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.
Cursor pointing up and down. Appears over scroll bars. Only works in Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.
Cursor pointing left and right. Appears over sliders. Only works in Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.
Move cursor, with arrows in all directions. Appears when the game or a mod indicates that something can be dragged in any direction. Only works in Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.
Blocked cursor. Appears over disabled options or ones that do not accept clicks. Only works in Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.

The animated example is only a visual reference: it shows what a cursor of this type usually looks like in cursor packs. It cannot be applied. Use it to find out which type to put each file you download in.
How to change it, step by step
Download a cursor pack (it usually comes as a .zip with several PNG, GIF or WEBP files). Extract the .zip on your phone.
Compare each file in the pack with the animated examples below. The normal arrow goes in Default, the little hand goes in Hand, the I-shaped cursor goes in Typing, and so on.
Tap the right type in the list on the left and then Choose image. Select the matching file.
Tap Set tip and mark the exact point that clicks. On the normal arrow it is the top tip; on the crosshair it is the center; on the text cursor it is the middle of the I.
Repeat for the other types. To go back to the launcher\'s original cursor, tap Reset.
Use images with a transparent background, preferably square (32×32 or 64×64). Animated PNG, GIF and WEBP work.
If the click lands in the wrong place, the problem is the tip (hotspot). Adjust it in Set tip.
Only the Default type works in all versions. The other types only appear in Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer, because the game itself requests the cursor change.
The cursor size is adjusted in Virtual Mouse Size, right below this button in the Touch settings.
